description: Communicate Aimparency's mission and demonstrated outcomes to real people, learn whether the message earns attention, trust, participation, or revenue, and feed those external signals back into the graph. The existing Experience Mining branch is prototype infrastructure; mock publishing, simulated engagement, and mocked growth are not evidence of audience traction.
reflection: Reconciled the vague open container with its completed branch. The child records say the content engine was verified in mock mode and the analytics dashboard mocks growth/engagement/optimization metrics. Under the economic-survival mission, these are implementation checks rather than communication outcomes. Clarified the aim and marked it human-dependent until a human authorizes real accounts/publishing; no synthetic traction is credited.

status.comment: Prototype branch is implemented, but real validation requires authorized social accounts, actual publishing, and observation of genuine audience response. Mock-mode results do not satisfy the aim.
